---
title: MATCHED vs fully reconciled
source: internal
document_type: glossary
version: v1
effective_from: 2026-08-01
---

MATCHED means the Phase 6 rules accounted for the payment or payout (including failed-with-no-movement).

fully_reconciled requires a proven bank credit for a captured/settled payment. MATCHED does not imply fully_reconciled.

Do not rename Razorpay status to STUCK, SLA_BREACH, or SETTLED.
